categoryMetadataIdentifier.description:
The identifier for the metadata that this node represents (contextual to its category).
For example:
   For Entity category, the categoryMetadataIdentifier is the type name.
   For an Entity instance (ex: SourceCollection category), the categoryMetadataIdentifier is SourceCollection#id

package.description: The package that the node data is defined in.

metadataStatus.description: The status of the metadata binding

hasTransformer.description: Whether the mapping has a transformer defined

status.description: The state of the mapping node
